MAJOR: **Cross-platform sha equality (AC 3) is not actually proven by this change.** Encoding was the reported divergence source, but `git diff` byte-stream identity across Windows/Linux also depends on `core.autocrlf`/`.gitattributes` (content lines become CRLF → different sha), `core.eol`, `core.quotepath`, and diff-affecting config (`diff.external`, attributes-driven filters). Nothing in the diff addresses or tests this, and there is no automated evidence (e.g., a test that `diff_sha` is invariant when stdout bytes are decoded under a forced non-UTF-8 locale / simulated cp1252 environment). AC 3 ("same sha on Windows and Linux") is currently an assertion, not a verified property.
